title: I absolutely love the colors & product. However , the price is too high
text: I am always on the hunt for new lip gloss and lipstick . I decided to try this one on an Amazon daily deal. I loved the packaging , the presentation and the adorable blinged out handles ! The colors were perfect for my skin tone and I didn't feel over done. I don't have much time these days for a full face of makeup , but these lip colors always make me feel better ! It's not sticky , doesn't rub off on everything , stays on long without having to excessively reapply it. I was hooked ! However, when it went back to purchase more they were over $20 with tax and required a subscription :( With everything going on in the economy I just couldn't justify it for 2 lipglosses . For many this is a steal, but for those on a very restricted income, its not as feasible. If the price points changes or I don't have to subscribe to monthly payments I will definitely be a customer for life !
label: positive
